design_philosophy: A professional, scientific, and highly credible B2B pharmaceutical manufacturing interface. The tone is authoritative yet natural, blending sterile precision (white, modern typography) with natural Ayurvedic roots (deep green, brown, saffron accents). Generous whitespace and 'Tetris/Bento' grid layouts are used to organize technical information efficiently without overwhelming the user.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: Install 'lucide-react' for icons and 'framer-motion' for scroll reveal animations.
ROUTING: Use 'react-router-dom' to create paths for /, /about, /products, /blog, /contact.
HERO CONTRAST: Ensure the hero text is fully legible by applying a 'bg-black/50' or 'bg-emerald-950/60' overlay on the hero image.
COMPONENTS: Build the UI using plain React + Tailwind CSS. Avoid complex external component libraries unless necessary. Custom components give more freedom.
TEST IDS: Add 'data-testid' to absolutely every interactive element (buttons, form fields, nav links) and major section wrappers.
FORMS: Ensure the contact form has 'onSubmit' handlers, validation, and realistic UI feedback (success state) mocking the submission.
FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link for 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' into the public/index.html head, or import in index.css.
DO NOT use generic placeholder images. Use ONLY the URLs provided in this JSON.
Ensure generous spacing between sections (e.g., py-24 or py-32) to match premium B2B quality.
